title: pluchea zamalloae
intro: Pluchea zamalloae, commonly known as Zamalloa, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its various health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pluchea zamalloae include wound healing, treating respiratory issues, and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
